def pick_embedder(models: list, max_size_mb: int):
    """Best retrieval score AMONG models within the size budget.
    Returns the winning model's name, or None if nothing fits."""
    fits = [m for m in models if m["size_mb"] <= max_size_mb]
    if not fits:
        return None
    return max(fits, key=lambda m: m["retrieval"])["name"]

models = [
    {"name": "giant-7b-embed",   "retrieval": 60.2, "size_mb": 14000},
    {"name": "all-MiniLM-L6-v2", "retrieval": 41.9, "size_mb": 80},
    {"name": "bge-base-en-v1.5", "retrieval": 53.3, "size_mb": 440},
    {"name": "e5-large-v2",      "retrieval": 50.6, "size_mb": 1340},
]
print(pick_embedder(models, 500))
